answer.reason: The verses tell of the rod's sign as a serpent and of its use in two plagues on Egypt.

clauses.english: became a serpent when cast down, and a rod again when seized
clauses.quote: it became a rod in his hand

clauses.english: was stretched toward heaven, and the LORD sent thunder and hail on Egypt
clauses.quote: Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven

clauses.english: was stretched over Egypt, and an east wind brought the locusts
clauses.quote: the east wind brought the locusts

doubts: EXO 14:16 and EXO 17:5-6 give only God's commands about the rod at the sea and the rock, not the events, so they were left out.
EXO 17:9-11 does not say the rod was in the hand Moses held up, so the battle with Amalek was left out.
